title: Fix Warlock invocation prerequisite parsing
description:
Fix Warlock Eldritch Invocation prerequisite parsing from the ngcj SRD audit.

Problem:
Several invocation option prerequisites are clipped when the source wraps "Pact of the X feature" across lines/pages. The imported option data has prerequisite: "Pact of" and leaks the rest into the body text, e.g. "the Tome feature You can now inscribe...".

Affected examples:
- Book of Ancient Secrets
- Chains of Carceri
- Lifedrinker
- Thirsting Blade
- Voice of the Chain Master

Why this matters:
Deterministic tools cannot safely gate invocations if prerequisites are incomplete. A resolver needs to know whether an invocation requires Pact of the Tome, Pact of the Blade, Pact of the Chain, a minimum Warlock level, or both.

Scope:
- Fix extraction/parsing of wrapped invocation prerequisites.
- Add structured prerequisite fields for invocation options where possible.
- Preserve original prerequisite prose for DM context.
- Correct source attribution for invocation options spanning SRD pages 48-50, instead of collapsing them all to page 47.
- Add regression tests for wrapped prerequisite lines.

Acceptance criteria:
- No invocation option has prerequisite exactly "Pact of" or similarly dangling prerequisite fragments.
- Book of Ancient Secrets requires Pact of the Tome.
- Lifedrinker and Thirsting Blade require Pact of the Blade and the correct minimum Warlock level where present in the SRD.
- Chains of Carceri and Voice of the Chain Master expose their correct prerequisites.
- Option body text no longer begins with leaked prerequisite continuations such as "the Tome feature".
- Source pages/citations are accurate for invocation options spanning pages 48-50.
- npm run typecheck passes.
- npm test passes.
- npm run check passes.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passes and regenerated pack output is intentional.
